_about: Interest areas. The ledger flags every lead whose title or summary matches, and the editor must decide on each flagged lead. They widen what the editor looks at; they never pick stories on their own. Values are Python regexes. Edit freely. Main focus: immigration, jobs, finance; a little entertainment.
